उद्भट a.
1 Excellent,
pre-eminent; पदे पदे संति भटा रणोद्भटाः

.
--2 Exalted, magnanimous.
--टः
1 A fan for winnowing corn.
--2 A tortoise.

उद्भट One of the earliest writers on Alaṃkāra. He
was the chief Paṇḍita or Sabhāpati of king
Jayāpīda of Kāshmir (779-813 A. D.).

.
--2 (fig.) To
bring into prominence, elevate,
exalt; उद्भासिताखिलखलस्य

उद्भासिन्, उद्भासुर a. Shining,
radiant, splendid; विभूषणोद्भासि
पिनद्धभोगि वा

उद्भासिन्, उद्भासुर a. Shining,
radiant, splendid; विभूषणोद्भासि
पिनद्धभोगि वा

उद्भिद् {c7c} U. To break up. --pass.
To break out, burst forth, become
visible, be produced; अद्यापि पक्षावपि
नोद्भिद्येते

उद्भिद् a. [उद्-भिद्-क्विप्]
1
Sprouting, germinating, shooting forth.
--2 Penetrating.
--3 Destroying.
--4
Causing to come forth. --m.
1 A
sprout or shoot (of a plant);
अंकुरोऽभिनवोद्भिदि Ak.
--2 A plant;
उद्भिदस्तरुगुल्माद्याः Ak.
--3 A spring,
fountain.
--Comp.
--ज a. (उद्भिज्ज)
sprouting, germinating (as a
plant).
--(ज्जः) a plant; उद्भिज्जाः
स्थावराः सर्वे बीजकांडप्रारेहिणः

उद्भिद a. Sprouting, germinating.
--दं Culinary salt.

उद्भिन्न p. p.
1 Produced,
generated, developed; formed; स्वयमेव
ब्रह्मबंधुनोद्भिन्नो दुर्गप्रयोगः

.
--3 Opened,
expanded, budded; as in यौवनोद्भिन्नशैशवा.
--4 Breaking out, appearing;
˚रोमपुलकैः Ch.

उद्भेदः, --दनं
1 Breaking through or
out, becoming visible, appearance,
display, manifestation, growth,
development; किसलयोद्भेदप्रतिद्वंद्विभिः
Ś. 4. 4; उमास्तनोद्भेदमनु प्रवृद्धः

.
--3 A spring, fountain.
--4
Horripilation; as in पुलकोद्भेद, रोमोद्भेद.
--5
Treason, betrayal.

उद्भेदः, --दनं
1 Breaking through or
out, becoming visible, appearance,
display, manifestation, growth,
development; किसलयोद्भेदप्रतिद्वंद्विभिः
Ś. 4. 4; उमास्तनोद्भेदमनु प्रवृद्धः

.
--3 A spring, fountain.
--4
Horripilation; as in पुलकोद्भेद, रोमोद्भेद.

To arise, spring up,
be produced from; उदभून्मुरजध्वनिः,
अंतरीक्षात्सरस्वती &c. see उद्भव below.
--2 To occur, take place;
उदभवत्तीव्रो दुर्भिक्षः

.
--3 To ascend,
go up, mount.
--4 To suffice.
--5
To rise in arms, revolt, rebel.
--

To cause to exist, create,
produce; मायां मयोद्भाव्य परीक्षितोसि

.
--3 To use, employ.
--4 To
raise, elevate.

1 Production, creation,
birth, generation (lit. and fig.);

; oft. at
the end of comp. in the sense of
‘springing or arising from,’
‘produced from’; ऊरूद्भवा

.
--3 N. of Viṣṇu;
उद्भवः क्षोभनो देवः V. Sah.
--Comp.
--कर a. productive.
--क्षेत्रं
birthplace.

1 Thinking, thinking over.
--2 Production, generation,
creation.
--3 Speaking, saying.
--4
Inattention, neglect, disregard.

उद्भूत p. p.
1 Born, produced,
generated.
--2 Lofty (lit. and fig.).
--3 Visible, perceptible, capable of
being perceived by the senses; as
a गुण.

उद्भूतिः f.
1 Generation,
production.
--2 Elevation, exaltation,
prosperity; वरः शंभुरलं ह्येष त्वत्कुलोद्भूतये
विधिः

उद्भ्रम् {c1c} {c4c} P. To wander, roam
about; धावत्युद्भ्रमति प्रमीलति
पतत्युद्याति मूर्छत्यपि

1 Whirling, turning round,
flourishing (as of a sword).
--2
Wandering.
--3 Regret.
--4 N. of a
class of beings attending on Śiva.

उद्भ्रांत p. p.
1 Agitated,
bewildered, distracted; ˚चेतनां

.
--3 Whirled, flourished,
waved (as a sword).
--4
[]
Wandering upwards.
--तं
1 Flourishing a
sword.
--2 (˚--तकं) Rising (in
the air).
